items.question: Within how many days must a negative balance from a declined credit card payment be settled?
items.fact: Declined card negative balance must be settled within 5 days

items.question: Can a user send Pay credit to a wallet that uses a different currency from their own?
items.gold: No, Pay credit can only be sent to a wallet with the same currency.
items.fact: Pay credit only sent to same-currency wallets
